title: Keyboard Navigation and Focus/ARIA Chronology — characterization

drivingSurface.keyboard: KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key, ctrlKey, metaKey, shiftKey, altKey, bubbles, cancelable}) dispatched on [part="input"] (the combobox)

observationSurface.aria: aria-expanded and aria-activedescendant read from the combobox; active option resolved via shadowRoot.getElementById(aria-activedescendant)
observationSurface.events: open / close CustomEvent.detail and onOpen / onClose
observationSurface.dom: data-open on host, data-placement on dropdown, dir on host, shadowRoot.activeElement

testRun.fullCoreSuite: 922 passed + 1 skipped (877 baseline + 45 new; no regressions)

coverageChange.KBD-001..012: Diagnostic -> Partial (keyboard paths characterized; real-browser conformance + pointer parity outstanding; NOT upgraded to Existing)

kbdContracts.KBD-001: ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Enter open the popup; open:{}->onOpen; no initial active-descendant; no duplicate open
kbdContracts.KBD-002: ArrowDown/ArrowUp move one selectable step, skip disabled, clamp at boundaries (no wrap)
kbdContracts.KBD-003: End -> last selectable; Home -> first selectable
kbdContracts.KBD-004: PageDown/PageUp move +/-10 selectable steps; clamp at end
kbdContracts.KBD-005: Enter/Space activate; Space on searchable input is a no-op
kbdContracts.KBD-006: Escape closes; close:{}->onClose; detail carries no reason (P1.3-D01)
kbdContracts.KBD-009: Disabled option never becomes active via keyboard
kbdContracts.KBD-010: Unmodified printable char moves active (type-ahead); modified char does not
kbdContracts.KBD-011: Focus stays on combobox input; active option expressed via aria-activedescendant
kbdContracts.KBD-012: aria-expanded false/true/false; aria-activedescendant null->set->cleared across open/move/close
